_what: The ONE docs-path admission rule (t261029-49). A path is admitted when it names a category directory of the derived documentation index and one plain .md file inside it, expressed as a path relative to the documentation root. Containment: the pattern starts at a category name, so an absolute path cannot match; the file segment is [^/]+, so a traversal segment or a nested directory cannot match; the extension check is the trailing .md.
_discipline: Both readers load this one file. The pattern must equal '^(' + categories.join('|') + ')/[^/]+<backslash>.md$' — both readers check that and refuse loudly when it does not hold, so this file cannot self-drift.
